clips.subtitleText: Level 1: Showed up in the exact same outfit and broke the ice with pure laughter
Level 2: The giant strawberry garnish slipped and turned dinner into uncontrollable giggles
Level 3: He told her she was stunning and she melted into the sweetest blushing smile
Level 4: Heard a street pianist by the harbour and asked her for an impromptu slow dance
Level 5: Gifted her a red rose and sealed the night with the sweetest first kiss
